changes.title: Skill commands prototype
items: Two fight prototypes are now on for everyone. Openings: hares, badgers and dormice sit still after attacking, glow amber when open, and enough letters during a wind-up stagger them. Commands: your creatures act when you tell them to (fox, squirrel, badger and bee for now), and berries give them charges
New buttons: square or F commands the bottom creature of your stack (near a berry it eats instead), circle or E picks up and puts down, and only L2 dodges
To turn either off, add ?skill=0 or ?commands=0 to the link; ?commands=0 also brings the old buttons back

changes.title: Single stick
items: New setting, Aiming (Settings, Controls): choose Single stick and her letters fly the way she moves, or the way she faces when she stands still, and home in on creatures more strongly. Twin stick, aiming with the mouse or the right stick, stays the default

changes.title: Circle sigil side
items: The legend circle baby's sigil now lands at the left or right edge of its legend's circle, so it's no longer picked up by accident when you go in to put a quest sigil down
